tasks.short: Provide professional language and literature consulting

steps.what: Agree the client's language, literature or communication consulting question
Examine client texts and relevant scholarly evidence
Write the consulting report and justified recommendations

loop.purpose: Draft explanatory wording from the teacher's checked findings
loop.input: checked findings, source passages and agreed scope entered by the teacher
loop.output: consulting report draft with source-linked claims
loop.check: Teacher checks meaning, quoted passages, interpretive qualifications, audience fit and unsupported recommendations against originals
loop.stop: Missing source support or two failed drafts means manual writing in retained time
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native report headings and citation fields first; variable explanation of textual findings still needs source-grounded wording and meaning review

steps.what: Check final recommendations, confidentiality, scope and client destination
outputs: final checked consulting report and destination

steps.what: Send the final checked consulting report to the client
inputs: final checked consulting report and destination

steps.what: Explain the report and discuss implications with the client

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} report and citation fields first, with a bounded wording loop for explanatory paragraphs from the teacher's checked textual findings. Keep consultation, scholarly interpretation, source verification and client discussion human; send the completed report only after its final check.
tasks.previous_blocker: The client needs defensible specialist interpretation rather than generic polished prose.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-limited drafting can shorten initial explanation wording after the teacher has done the substantive analysis.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous language, cultural context, competing interpretations and confidential client material.
tasks.human_edge: Offer a defensible interpretation and explain its limits to the client.
tasks.altitude: Some report wording is shorter; consulting judgement and professional responsibility remain.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded drafting from checked textual findings can assist report wording while the specialist retains interpretation and source verification.

assumptions: Boundary models a report-based consulting engagement within the teacher's language/literature expertise, not an invented recurring consulting client or measured baseline. Oral-only advice has a different work mix.

The client supplies the actual texts and question; the teacher defines scope in s1 and creates checked findings, source passages and references in s2. No structured evidence pack or free extraction is assumed: its preparation is counted in s2 and actual finding entry in s3.

Test native headings and citation tools first. Only first explanatory wording, 10% of s3, is removed; specialist recommendations, full meaning review and manual repair stay in its retained 90% and s4. Ordinary author saves remain fully retained and ungated.

s4 checks the completed report and exact client destination before s5; edits void approval. Client discussion is separate s6 and earns no saving. Access and confidentiality must permit any model use; otherwise keep manual wording.
unknowns: Wording repair effort on the relevant consulting subject
research_questions: Can source-limited drafting preserve interpretive qualifications without increasing report-checking time?

already_counted.description: Draft meaning review, repair and final report verification remain in s3-s4.

incremental.description: Teacher checks source restrictions and drafting behaviour after changes.

approvals.approved_version: s4 final checked consulting report, attachments and exact authorised client destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; 30*0.10=3 wording hours removed less 0.8 upkeep gives 2.2 net. Cautious case: interpretively contested texts need mostly original prose, leaving 0.9 hours of straightforward findings explanation removed and 0.1 net; analysis and client discussion stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Limited report wording assistance leaves specialist consulting and client accountability unchanged.
role.ambitious_version: No automatic consulting advice or broader professional authority is proposed.

job.title: English Language and Literature Teachers, Postsecondary
